description: This file contains interfaces and classes related to notification messages used in log view adaptors within Orleans event sourcing, including version tracking and batching functionalities.

classes.name: VersionNotificationMessage
classes.description: A notification message containing only a version number, used to indicate a specific version state.

classes.name: BatchedNotificationMessage
classes.description: A notification message that encapsulates a batch of individual notification messages, providing an aggregated version.

methods.name: VersionNotificationMessage.Version
methods.description: Property representing the version number of the notification message.

methods.name: BatchedNotificationMessage.Version
methods.description: Read-only property that returns the highest version number among the batch of notifications.
